name: TL OF Oak
description: Oak Wood (referred to as Generic internally) is the most accessible Wood type in the game. It can be easily cut with nearly every Axe and can be found in the Main Biome, Cherry Meadow, and the Mountainside.

name: TL OF Elm
description: Elm Wood (known in-game as Oak Wood) is an abundant and widely used species of Wood. It can be cut by most axes except the Candy Cane Axe. This type of wood is often cut up and sold in the Wood Dropoff as a quick way to make money for new players or used as a plentiful material for making long planks or filling in Blueprints.

name: TL OF Cherry
description: Cherry Wood is a commonly used type of wood in the game. The wood frequently spawns in the Cherry Meadow - a spot in the Main Biome where this tree spawns in great quantities. This wood also spawns in places in the Main Biome and in the Safari.

name: TL OF Walnut
description: Walnut Wood is a type of Wood that was added on August 14th, 2015, growing exclusively in the Safari. Its relatively low value and its location make Walnut Wood an inefficient choice for farming for Money. However, due to its dark color, it is a popular choice of wood used for building.

name: TL OF Fir
description: Fir Wood is a type of wood that is exclusive within the Taiga. It is commonly confused with Pine Wood. Despite them having the same appearance, they both contrast on special file properties that establish them as different from one another.

name: TL OF Pine
description: Pine Wood is a species of wood that is found exclusively in the Taiga. It is usually confused with Fir Wood, but both contrast on special file properties that establish them as different from each other.

name: TL OF Lava
description: Volcano Wood, also referred to as Lava Wood, Red Wood, or Fire Wood, is the only tree that grows at the peak of the Volcano.

name: TL OF Spook
description: Spooky Wood, also referred to as Spook Wood, is a type of wood that was introduced during the 2015 Halloween Update along with Sinister Wood.

name: TL OF Phantom
description: Phantom Wood, also known as End Times Wood, is a variant of Wood that was added during the 2016 End Times Update. It is located in the Lone Cave and is the most valuable wood (as both Logs and Planks) in the game when sold at the Wood Dropoff.

TL OF Birch
description: Birch Wood is a type of wood that can be found in both the Mountainside and Tropics biomes. Birch wood serves a popular wood choice for newer players looking to farm for money owing to the ideal balance between its value and the short time it takes to travel to and harvest it. Its ease of obtaining and light color also serve to make Birch wood a popular choice for building.

name: TL OF Blue Spruce
description: Blue Spruce, also known as Bspruce or Bruce is a wood type that was introduced during the 2023 Christmas Event. It returns annually every Winter event.

name: TL OF Cavecrawler
description: Cavecrawler Wood, commonly referred to as Blue Wood and historically, Electric Wood, is a wood type that grows exclusively in the Cavecrawler Cavern within the Maze. It was added during the January Mega Update.

name: TL OF Frost
description: Frost Wood, commonly referred to as Ice Wood, is the only type of wood that grows at the Taiga Peak. It was added to the game on May 13th, 2018, finally making use of the Taiga Mountain Passage.

name: TL OF Gold
description: Gold Wood or Gold Swamp Wood (referred to in the game files as "GoldSwampy") is a naturally colored wood that was added on August 28, 2015. It is located exclusively within the Swamp, along with Zombie Wood. Gold wood is worth slightly more than Lava Wood, but the time-consuming nature of travelling to and from the Swamp to harvest Gold Wood deters most players from harvesting it as a money source, often instead opting to harvest Lava Wood or Frost Wood.

name: TL OF Gray
description: Gray Wood is a blueprint that has no defined, or [https://www.lua.org/pil/2.1.html nil], wood type. It was only obtainable through glitches at various points in LT2 history. As its name suggests, it has a medium gray color.

name: TL OF Koa
description: Koa Wood is a type of wood found exclusively within the Tropics. It is most commonly used to fill in blueprints rather than for selling, as its location and sell price make it an inefficient source of money.

name: TL OF Maple
description: Maple Wood is a Wood type that was introduced on November 1st, 2026.

name: TL OF Palm
description: Palm Wood is a type of wood exclusive to the Sand Islands which was added on January 23rd, 2016.

name: TL OF Pink
description: Pink Wood was a mysterious wood type in Lumber Tycoon 2 that has since been removed from the game. It has the same exterior as Oak, but with a pink interior.

name: TL OF Sinister
description: Sinister Wood is a type of wood that was introduced during the 2015 Halloween Update, along with Spooky Wood. Its appearance became an annual occurrence every successive October. It is the most elusive tree in the game, having a 1% chance to spawn in place of a Spook tree. Sinister wood is the most time-consuming wood to fully cut compared to all other woods in Lumber Tycoon 2.

name: TL OF Snowglow
description: Snowglow Wood, officially Glowing Fir Wood, and sometimes by the community Yellow Wood, is a variant of Wood that was first introduced for the duration of the Winter Games 2017 Event. It was reintroduced inside of the Ticktatwert memorial.

name: TL OF Zombie
description: Zombie Wood, also known as Green Wood, is a type of Wood found exclusively in the Swamp along with Gold Wood. Its leaves are grey with the granite texture and have a square surface. When milled, it produces a bright green plank. Its leaves look like a grey countertop sold at Fancy Furnishings. Both Zombie Wood and Gold Wood were added on August 28, 2015.
